summary: Earnings analysis for Alphabet Inc. is constructive but execution-sensitive. The latest actual period shows revenue growth and earnings resilience, while the forecast depends on continued margin expansion, cost discipline, and demand durability. The key debate is whether Alphabet Inc. can sustain EPS growth and justify its valuation premium through product-cycle execution, recurring revenue growth, and operating leverage.
key_points: Alphabet Inc. generated $403.0B of revenue in 2025A; latest observed revenue growth was 15.1%, providing the starting point for the earnings forecast.
Year-over-year revenue growth was 15.1%, indicating a strong acceleration in top-line momentum.

EPS increased to $10.91 in 2025A and is forecast to reach $13.01 by 2027E; the implied earnings upside depends on sustaining revenue growth while converting margin expansion into per-share profit growth.
EBITDA is forecast to increase from $180.0B in 2025A to $241.1B in 2027E; this makes operating leverage and margin execution the central earnings debate.

EBITDA margin is projected to expand from 44.7% in 2025A to 51.7% in 2027E; the magnitude of this step-up should be treated as an important execution assumption rather than a mechanical extrapolation.
Contribution margin is expected to rise from 59.7% to 62.7%, supporting the earnings growth outlook through pricing discipline, services mix, and cost control.
SG&A margin is expected to move from 12.5% to 11.0%, indicating continued cost discipline.
